newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong homeless woman not penniless.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong homeless woman not penniless.

text.p: An elderly homeless woman who collapsed and died on Saturday was found to have more than HK$340,000 ($43,600) among her clothes and belongings, police said on Sunday.
The woman was identified by the South China Morning Post newspaper as Tsui Mong-kok, 76.
The newspaper said she regularly slept under a flyover near Hong Kong's Central business district since being dismissed from her job as a maid about four years ago.
